businessPlan: Add the first MVP slice of optional Serena semantic navigation support: users must be able to leave semantic navigation absent/disabled with unchanged workflow behavior, or opt into an external Serena MCP setup through project workflow config without editing TypeScript. The business invariant is that workflow truth and evidence gates remain unchanged; Serena is only an optional navigation backend. Invalid Serena provider/mode values must be visible as configuration diagnostics and must not crash normal workflow config loading.
technicalPlan: Implement this as synchronous configuration plumbing only. Add typed SemanticNavigation config shapes to extensions/workflow/types.ts with supported provider `serena`, supported modes `disabled` and `external`, role access levels, fallback flag, and configurable Serena tool-name lists. Add conservative disabled defaults in extensions/workflow/defaults.ts. Extend v1 normalization in extensions/workflow/config/normalize.ts so semanticNavigation is accepted and invalid fields are dropped instead of thrown. Extend extensions/workflow/runtime/config.ts load paths to normalize semanticNavigation from v1/v2 compatibility overlays and append warning diagnostics for unsupported provider/mode values, including `managed` as future/not implemented. Add smoke tests in scripts/task-001-serena-semantic-navigation-config-smokes.ts for absent/default, enabled external config, and invalid provider/mode diagnostics. Update docs/workflow-config-v2.md and docs/prd-serena-semantic-navigation.md with external MCP setup, supported modes, non-goals/limitations, and managed future scope. No MCP lifecycle, tool-profile wiring, prompt guidance, repo-memory rewrite, or finalization evidence changes in this task.
parallelAssessment: Decision: serial. Although code/tests and documentation look separable, the documentation must reflect the exact normalized schema and diagnostic codes introduced in code, and the touched files are a small coherent config slice. Brain marker parallel=auto is therefore assessed as not safely worth parallel execution for TASK-001; no workflow room is needed.
contractBlockPlan: Blocks: (1) Config contract/types owned by extensions/workflow/types.ts: SemanticNavigationProvider, SemanticNavigationMode, role access, and SemanticNavigationConfig. (2) Defaults owned by extensions/workflow/defaults.ts: semanticNavigation disabled, provider serena, mode disabled, fallback enabled, standard role policy, empty tool lists. (3) Normalization owned by extensions/workflow/config/normalize.ts: accept semanticNavigation, normalize booleans/strings/roles/tool arrays, drop invalid provider/mode without throwing. (4) Runtime diagnostics owned by extensions/workflow/runtime/config.ts: collect warning diagnostics for unsupported provider/mode on both .pi/workflow.json and .pi/workflow.local.json normal load paths. (5) Smoke tests owned by scripts/task-001-serena-semantic-navigation-config-smokes.ts. (6) Documentation owned by docs/workflow-config-v2.md and docs/prd-serena-semantic-navigation.md. Build all blocks serially and keep default profiles/tool profiles unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Config loader accepts absent config and defaults to disabled.
Config loader accepts enabled external Serena config without TypeScript source edits.
Invalid provider/mode emits diagnostics instead of throwing in normal load paths.
Documentation explains external MCP setup, supported modes, non-goals, and limitations.
Managed mode remains documented future scope, not implemented in MVP.
